notes.title: New Update Available Now
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

A new update for The Pandora Directive is available now which includes the following:

Linux - Improved Launcher
Linux - Updated Libraries and DOSBox build
Mac - Fixed game not having a default sound setup.
Mac - Upgraded to Boxer 2.0 engine. This is a huge change and you will need to rename the save file which the old version of Boxer was using. Go into /Users/Your Name/Library/Application Support/Boxer/Gamebox States/, find the folder called 'CDEA277D-2292-476E-9840-34F9FA1A2411' and rename it to 'TM The Pandora Directive'. Apologies for the inconvenience. This will not happen again but it is necessary in order to provide future updates.


Enjoy the game!
